:::{.cr-section}

Closeread lets you pin content in a sticky column while narrative text scrolls past. @cr-poem

The sticky element stays in view as you read. Here we highlight the first line. [@cr-poem]{highlight="1"}

And now we zoom into the last two lines. [@cr-poem]{highlight="3-4" zoom-to="3"}

:::{#cr-poem}
| Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
| And sorry I could not travel both
| And be one traveler, long I stood
| And looked down one as far as I could
:::

Next, a different sticky: a simple diagram. @cr-box

:::{#cr-box}
```
+---------+      +---------+
|  Text   | ---> | Sticky  |
+---------+      +---------+
```
:::
